verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single community remark that ClickUp has real-time chat, which implies live updates within Chat only. No first-party documentation describes live sync of task, doc, or whiteboard changes across open sessions. The Brain² 'real-time' claim describes the AI's awareness of the workspace, and the Slack, Teams and Figma real-time items are integrations, so neither counts toward this story. Missing for 10: first-party docs on live multi-user sync for tasks, docs and views; evidence of instant updates without refresh outside Chat; hands-on corroboration.
